scientificScope.title: Ethics, equity, and decision scope
scientificScope.summary: CeresPINN is not calibrated at county scale and does not validly identify territories with greater agricultural vulnerability.
scientificScope.limitSpatial: Field comparisons are neither maps nor rankings of territorial vulnerability.
scientificScope.limitSoil: The soil profile changes the daily water balance but is not a direct input to the yield neural network.
scientificScope.prohibited: Do not use for public policy, water allocation, insurance, credit, financing, or territorial prioritization.
scientificScope.required: Those uses require real spatial data, independent geographic validation, representativeness analysis, and explicit uncertainty.
scientificScope.scenarioExplanation: Compare three exploratory configurations and their simulated yield, water and margin results. Management rules are not calibrated for field recommendations.
scientificScope.comparingWater: Comparing the demonstration water balance and parameterized evapotranspiration across three scenarios.

baselineAudit.scope: Retrospective audit of the predictor and its assumptions. This application is a simulation prototype; its neural network does not solve differential equations or constitute an operational digital twin.
baselineAudit.sobolScope: Sobol: model diagnostic under independent perturbations, without causal interpretation.
baselineAudit.metricLimit: Metric from the available evaluation; it does not establish future generalization.
baselineAudit.nrmseLimit: Interpretation depends on the dataset and evaluation protocol.
baselineAudit.title: Retrospective comparison with baseline models
baselineAudit.design: Five expanding windows, 20 distinct test years (2006–2025). Models evaluated on the same years; descriptive intervals use three-year blocks.
baselineAudit.interpretation: Ridge and linear regression had lower point errors than the network. All four Holm-adjusted comparisons had p = 1; neither superiority nor equivalence is established. This is a retrospective internal audit, not external validation.
baselineAudit.hindcastDescription: Observations and predictions supplied by the service; this chart does not establish future validation.
baselineAudit.prototypeView: 3D prototype and phenological dynamics (Zea mays L.)
baselineAudit.effect: Mean MAE difference (network minus Ridge): +{{difference}} kg/ha; Holm-adjusted p = {{p}}. A positive value favors Ridge.
